description: Start a MergeSafe review session for local changes, before or without a pull request; nothing is posted to GitHub. FIRST ask the user for a cost limit for the session in US dollars and pass it as limit_usd: reviews stop when it is reached until the user approves more. Returns the session_id and how reviews are priced (level rate x review size).

base.description: The branch the change is against.

limit_usd.description: The cost limit the user chose, in US dollars.

name: start_session
title: Start a local review session
